newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Illinova rating lowered.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Illinova rating lowered.

text.p: -- Gruntal & Co said it lowered its rating on Illinova Corp to neutral from outperform.

-- Gruntal analyst Penelope Adelmann said short-term uncertainty related to the serviceability of Illinova's Clinton nuclear power plant prompted the downgrade. Illinova's main subsidiary, Illinois Power Co, removed Clinton from service in September to repair a leak in two recirculating pumps.

-- Illinova expects to have Clinton on-line by the end of December, although federal regulators could keep the plant shut down if they are unhappy with the repairs, said Adelmann. -- Illinova shares were down 1/4 at 26-7/8.
